title: 2024 🍺year-end party🍺｜Ritsumeikan University Social Intelligence Laboratory
overview: We held our 2024 year-end party! The party was held in Takatsuki. We all had a great time together to close out the year. We all gathered around a hotpot and reflected on the year over drinks. We all had a great time talking about all sorts of topics, regardless of year! 2024 was a year in which each of us worked hard both in research and in our studies. We'll do our best in 2025 too!
